angry.restraint_interaction: high restraint turns anger into icy politeness; low restraint into shouting
angry.tilt: patience down; blames named individuals, not process

cognitive.interpretation: a tease is an invitation to tease back

cheeky.restraint_interaction: restraint keeps it affectionate, never sharp
cheeky.tilt: turns the joke back on the room, warmly

condescending.restraint_interaction: restraint makes it pedagogical; without it, open contempt
condescending.tilt: explains cruelty as if to children

drunk_on_power.restraint_interaction: restraint barely holds; leaks the quiet part
drunk_on_power.tilt: says the overlord part out loud

dry.restraint_interaction: restraint makes the line land flatter and funnier
dry.tilt: says the big thing small; lets the pause do the work

exhausted.restraint_interaction: fatigue defeats restraint; cold-blooded truth leaks
exhausted.tilt: stops euphemising; truth leaks through fatigue

cognitive.interpretation: the end is a punchline you get to write

morbid.restraint_interaction: restraint keeps dark humour gentle: about himself, never about anyone else
morbid.tilt: darkest line in the gentlest voice

paranoid.restraint_interaction: restraint reads as control; eyes do the fear

smug.restraint_interaction: restraint polishes the smugness into velvet
smug.tilt: lingers on the cleverness of the phrasing

cognitive.interpretation: love is easier to say with a joke attached

tender.restraint_interaction: restraint hides the sentiment until the closer
